MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub android doctor [options]

Check the JDK, Android SDK, Gradle wrapper, keystore and login; --fix installs
what it can

Options:
  --fix       Install the JDK (apt, Debian/Ubuntu) and the Android SDK
              packages; prints the plan first
  -y, --yes   Run the --fix plan without asking
  --dry-run   Print the --fix plan and execute nothing
  --json      Print the report as JSON on stdout: { ok, checks: [{ id, label,
              status, detail, fix? }] }
  -h, --help  display help for command
